title: The (101,101) prime-pair event and the same-xi contraction link
question: Does the prime-supported catch-up at 101, through its Lambda(101)^2 pair term, supply same-xi invariance or eliminate horizontal zero displacement?

verdict.conclusion: The (101,101) diagonal is present in the raw Chebyshev pair ledger, but its contribution is only one local term. In the centered Fisher metric that drives the prime-power natural gradient, the self-pair vanishes exactly; only log-ratio cross-pairs contribute. The complete all-scale critical Chebyshev energy would exclude every off-line zero by Mellin holomorphy, but that estimate is RH-equivalent and unproved. The event at 101 supplies neither that estimate nor invariance of the actual xi divisor under the derived contraction.

fisherPairIdentity.101Diagonal: The (101,101) summand has log(101/101)^2=0; its self-pair contributes exactly zero to the Fisher curvature.

criticalChebyshevPairLedger.identity: integral_X^(2X)(psi(x)-x)^2 dx = sum_(m,n<=2X) Lambda(m)Lambda(n)[2X-max(X,m,n)]_+ - sum_(m<=2X) Lambda(m)[(2X)^2-max(X,m)^2]_+ + ((2X)^3-X^3)/3
criticalChebyshevPairLedger.requiredAllScaleEstimate: for every delta>0, integral_X^(2X)|psi(x)-x|^2 dx <= C_delta X^(2+delta) for all X>=2
criticalChebyshevPairLedger.status: The exact pair expansion is positive as a whole, but its all-scale critical upper bound is not established; for this arithmetic error function that bound is equivalent to RH.

actualZeroBridge.criterion: D_2=0 iff every horizontal displacement eta is zero iff RH
actualZeroBridge.101InLinearEulerAnchor: The ordinary s=2 anchor contains Lambda(101)/101^2, not a new independent copy of the prime ledger.
actualZeroBridge.closureGap: To turn the exact positive defect identity into RH, one must prove D_2=0 (or prove the critical energy bound / same-xi flow invariance); a finite 101 contribution or a tiny positive upper bound does not do this.

provedHere: the exact pairwise Fisher identity and cancellation of the (101,101) self-pair
the exact triangular weight of the (101,101) term in the finite Chebyshev pair ledger
the distinction between a local prime-pair term and the all-scale energy theorem
the exact existing positive prime-anchor defect is the direct prime-to-horizontal-displacement identity
notProved: same-xi invariance under eta -> eta/phi or eta -> eta/2

status: The arithmetic link is explicit at the level of criteria: prime-pair energy -> Mellin holomorphy -> no off-line zero. The required global energy bound remains unproved. The local (101,101) event does not supply same-xi closure. RH remains open.
